def_en: 1) to ban, devote, destroy utterly, completely destroy, dedicate for destruction, exterminate
1a2) to consecrate, devote, dedicate for destruction
1b1) to be put under the ban, be devoted to destruction
2) to split, slit, mutilate (a part of the body)
kjv: make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).
expl: to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physical and reflexive, to be blunt as to the nose
